title: Liz and the Zip
lines: Liz has a red bag, and it zips up.
Zac and Liz set a bun and a nut in it.
Liz tugs at the zip. It is not up.
A bit of rag is in the zip!
Liz tugs at the rag. Zip! It is up!
"You did it," said Zac, and Liz nods.
Liz and Zac zig and zag to the den.
Liz has the bun, and Zac has the nut.

questions.ask: Why would the zip not go up?
questions.listenFor: A bit of rag was caught in it. Line four says it. Let your child reread that line rather than being told.

questions.ask: Who got the zip working again?
questions.listenFor: Liz did it herself. Line five says it. If they say Zac, ask them to find the line with the rag in it.

questions.ask: Tell me about a time something of yours got stuck.
questions.listenFor: Any story of their own. Liz's zip stuck on a bit of rag in line four. A real zip is a good prop.
